ns2:course.label: Basketball Band
ns2:course.description: Performs for home basketball games. Credit is given for spring term only. Open to all students who have been accepted by audition, with assignments made according to proficiency and instrumentation. Completion of each course involves, in addition to the regular schedule of rehearsals, participation in public performances by the band. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Band Division audition during early October, or consent of instructor.
